title: Design System: Shield XL Light Console

display.purpose: PLAY header only: custom 13-row LIGHT CTRL caps in a 16px band.

label.purpose: Every operator string. Uppercase bitmap in 6×8 cells.

motion.name: activity-scan
motion.value: 6 frames, 0.16s each, 3px × 1px, LTR wrap, never reverse
motion.purpose: Only while a live signal is progressing now. Idle draws nothing.

components.name: Page
components.description: The only canvas: 128×64 pit with ink.
components.css: .ds-page { width: 128px; height: 64px; background: #000; color: #fff; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 7px; line-height: 8px; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: uppercase; image-rendering: pixelated; }

components.name: Status row
components.description: Label left, vocab word right, optional warn square and activity slot.
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; width: 116px; height: 8px; padding-left: 4px; background: #000; color: #fff; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 7px; line-height: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-word { letter-spacing: 0; }

components.name: Toggle on
components.description: Filled 7px circle: the operator’s enabled choice.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 8px; padding-left: 4px; background: #000; color: #fff; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 7px; line-height: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-toggle-disk { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 7px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-toggle-on .ds-toggle-disk { background: #fff; }

components.name: Toggle off
components.description: Outline 7px circle: the operator’s disabled choice.

components.name: Focus rail
components.css: .ds-row-focus { display: flex; align-items: stretch; height: 8px; background: #000; color: #fff; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 7px; line-height: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-rail { width: 2px; background: #fff; margin-right: 2px; } .ds-row-focus span { line-height: 8px; }

components.name: Warn mark
components.description: 3×3 ink square beside FAILED / LOST / OFFLINE / AP FAILED / BRIDGE FAILED.
components.css: .ds-warn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; height: 8px; background: #000; color: #fff; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 7px; line-height: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-warn i { width: 3px; height: 3px; background: #fff; }

components.name: Activity scan
components.description: 3×1 px LTR scan. Movement means happening now.
components.css: .ds-activity { position: relative; width: 9px; height: 8px; background: #000; } .ds-activity i { position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 1px; width: 3px; height: 1px; background: #fff; animation: ds-scan 0.96s steps(6) infinite; } @keyframes ds-scan { 0% { left: 1px; } 100% { left: 6px; } }

components.name: Empty state
components.description: Centered uppercase empty word. No illustration.
components.css: .ds-empty { width: 128px; height: 56px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #000; color: #fff; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 7px; line-height: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Lifecycle frame
components.description: Full pit, one centered sentence, nothing else.
components.css: .ds-life { width: 128px; height: 64px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #000; color: #fff; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 7px; line-height: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
This is a lighting desk in the dark. The SSD1322 is the only page. The operator’s hands are on K1–K3 and E1–E3; the screen reports. It is an instrument, not an app. Norns grammar tells you how to read the page: PLAY versus MENU, physical control names, one 128×64 frame for every screen.

Density is the point. Eight rows of 8 px, a 5×7 bitmap in 6×8 cells (~21 columns), uppercase labels, no chrome. The Mac window is a scaled copy of that framebuffer, not a second interface.

Confirmed rejections: do not become a dashboard, Material, or a Mac-native layout. Stay 1-bit unless a real hierarchy need appears. Do not invent greys, glows, or a palette because the panel can do 4-bit greyscale.
keyCharacteristics: Instrument first: keys and encoders are the UI
Norns reading grammar without being Norns OS
STATIC CONTROL / STATIC STATUS / MOVEMENT as the only visual verbs

rules.name: The 1-Bit Rule
rules.body: There is no grey, no glow, no accent. Warn is still ink: a 3×3 square beside the word. If you need a third color, you are off the Night Desk.

rules.name: The OLED Ink Rule
rules.body: Do not lock a web hex as brand. Simulator (210, 220, 160) is a Mac preview of phosphor, not identity.

rules.name: The Vocab Rule
rules.body: Editable booleans are only ON / OFF. Observed words live in light_console/ui/vocab.py. Do not invent sentence case, icons-as-type, or title case marketing lines.

rules.name: The Twenty-One Column Rule
rules.body: A row is ~21 cells. Prefer a shorter word over a smaller font. Marquee is for the focused field, not decoration.

rules.name: The One Page Rule
rules.body: Every screen is this frame. Do not add a sidebar, tab bar, modal, or a second resolution.

rules.name: The No Invert Rule
rules.body: Never invert a row or the page to show selection.

rules.name: The Circle Means Choice Rule
rules.body: Disks are for operator-chosen toggles only. Status is a word, not a LED.

dos: Do design every screen as 128×64 with 8 px rows and the 5×7 label face.
Do use OLED Ink on Pit only; warn with a 3×3 square plus a vocab word.
Do show choice as filled/outline 7 px circles and selection as a 2 px rail.
Do reserve movement for “happening now”; keep control and status static.
Do keep the Mac window a scaled copy of the same framebuffer.
donts: Don't introduce a web/dashboard/Material layout or a second Mac UI.
Don't add greys, glows, drop shadows, or a 4-bit ramp “because the panel can.”
Don't invert rows to show focus.
Don't use sentence-case body copy, webfonts, or icons-as-navigation.
Don't treat activity/ACTIVE as reachability of AIR2DMX or LIGHT-CONTROL.
